name: 25005-visionchat-qwen2vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.3B params: a 32-block vision tower feeding a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=100, bounded at 1000 requests, warmup the first 30% by completion, 1800 s safety cap.
workload: Image+text chat from `merve/vqav2-small`, split `validation`, through GuideLLM's `huggingface` deserializer with its default column mapping (`question` -> text, `image` -> image). One image and one short question per request, roughly 380 prompt tokens, `max_tokens: 1`, `temperature: 0.0`. Rows are consumed in order and do not repeat within a run. Served in-process through the `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant answering short image-and-text questions from 100 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct

trust-remote-code: true

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The worst case on the wire is under 600 prompt tokens and one output token.
max-model-len: 4096

# HAZARD: async-scheduling is known-unstable on this cluster and is not set.
